name: ModelVariant451_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant451_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (the header-412 entry with one swarm of up to 16 sprites in place of the trail and flares, released either along a sweep toward the opposite slot or around a point above it, and drawn by the header-134612 swarm helper); for a non-negative request it sets the effect up from the command row indexed by the request, otherwise it runs one frame; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the French header-468/618 images build the same source through french_model_variant/variant468_entry.c with VERSION_FRENCH, binding the data label 8 bytes lower. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
